circleI.name: Spark Needle
circleI.effect: Deal 1 hit to a foe in your zone or an adjacent zone.

circleI.name: Glass Veil
circleI.effect: One ally in your zone gains Guard.
circleI.overcast: That ally also restores 1 Armor box

circleI.name: Dust Bind
circleI.effect: Bind one foe in your zone.

circleI.name: Shard Mend
circleI.effect: Heal 1 Hit on one ally in your zone.

circleI.name: Static Kiss
circleI.effect: A foe in your zone loses Guard.

circleI.name: Vein Sense
circleI.effect: Mark one foe in any zone.

circleI.name: Ash Whisper
circleI.effect: Deal 1 hit to a foe in any zone.

circleI.name: Null Soften
circleI.effect: Until your next round, foes in your zone deal 1 less hit (minimum 1).

circleI.name: Cinder Seal
circleI.effect: Set one foe in your zone Burning.

circleI.name: Pattern Brace
circleI.effect: Restore 1 Armor box on yourself or an ally in your zone.
circleI.overcast: Restore 2 boxes, split as you like

circleI.name: Borrowed Face
circleI.effect: Raise one unassigned party die by $+1$ (max 6).

circleII.name: Lance Lattice
circleII.effect: Deal 3 hits to one foe in any zone.

circleII.name: Bastion Glass
circleII.effect: Allies in your zone gain Guard and restore 1 Armor box each.

circleII.name: Rift Pull
circleII.effect: Pull one foe from any zone into yours; deal 2 hits.

circleII.name: Choir Bolt
circleII.effect: Deal 1 hit to every foe in one zone.

circleII.name: Horizon Lock
circleII.effect: Until your next round, foes cannot leave your zone; each takes 1 hit.

circleII.name: Mirror Cage
circleII.effect: Until your next round, the first hit against an ally in your zone is dealt to its attacker instead.

circleII.name: Shatter Note
circleII.effect: Deal 2 hits to one foe; it loses Guard and is Marked.

circleII.name: Flesh Dust
circleII.effect: Heal 2 Hits on each ally in your zone.

circleII.name: False Door
circleII.effect: Until your next round, one ally in your zone cannot be targeted.

circleIII.name: Breaking Light
circleIII.effect: Deal 4 hits to one foe in any zone, ignoring Armor.

circleIII.name: Lattice Absolute
circleIII.effect: Until your next round, allies in your zone ignore all hits; you take 1 hit.

circleIII.name: Oblivion Pinch
circleIII.effect: Remove one Minion from the fight, or deal 5 hits to a Brute.
circleIII.overcast: Deal 5 hits to an Elite instead of removing a Minion

circleIII.name: Thunder Choir
circleIII.effect: Deal 2 hits to every foe on the battle field.

circleIII.name: Starless Veil
circleIII.effect: Until your next round, no ally can be targeted by foes outside your zone.
circleIII.overcast: Also grant Guard to all allies in your zone

circleIII.name: Unmaking
circleIII.effect: Deal 5 hits to one foe and 2 hits to each other foe in its zone.
circleIII.overcast: Ignore Guard on all those hits

circleIII.name: The Cage Holds
circleIII.effect: Every foe on the battle field is Bound and skips its next phase.

circleIII.name: Last Hymn
circleIII.effect: Until your next round every ally ignores all hits and heals 1 Hit.
